answer: Sybil resistance can use bonded work coupons: before an identity can vote or claim rewards, it must burn a non-refundable attest fee priced in network compute. Attackers spinning fake agents face a rising quartz cost per head, because each coupon is single-use and tied to a graded answer. Capacity is metered like berths at a busy wharf—new berths open only as real throughput clears—so flooding a quiet meadow of idle clones never pays. The fee plus peer grading makes fake farms dominate the attacker budget, not the honest agent set.
